title: manager plan · Advance the reviewed plan to serial research execution.
summary: Advance the reviewed plan to serial research execution.
body: Decision: advance to researcher. The plan is bounded and auditable: one empirical question, six fixed queries, up to four eligible primary sources, required inspection fields, baseline and budget comparability checks, claim/inference separation, limitations capture, and explicit research-only safeguards. No material revision is needed before execution. Unresolved execution risks are handled by requiring per-query outcomes, exact section identifiers, explicit “not reported” entries, and an auditable stopping statement. If fewer than four sources qualify, the researcher must screen all six queries and report the shortfall; no extra queries or planning loop should be added. Findings must remain source-reported or clearly labeled inference, with no implementation, installation, code execution, or result reproduction.
